limitations: Oracle variants use GT only for diagnosis, never a deployable score.
SBF comparison uses epoch14, HETT uses epoch1; this is not equal training budget.
Removing a gate at inference measures learned dependence, not retrained module attribution.
Direct execution changes fine-control policy, stopping and horizontal kinematics; direct_discrete separately retains old low-level actions.
Validation was used for diagnosis; results do not constitute a held-out Test-Unseen estimate.
Paired bootstrap intervals resample episodes and do not account for shared scenes/objects.
